entries.body:
CURRENT [S1.1] Format: CSV via csv.writer default dialect, lineterminator \n; header id,title,owner,amount; rows ascending id; no records -> header only.
CURRENT [S1.2] Scope: role admin exports any project; others only records with project in user projects (others silently omitted).
CURRENT [S1.3] Status: only active, unless params include_archived is True then archived too.
CURRENT [S1.4] Date filter: params since YYYY-MM-DD -> only created >= since.
CURRENT [S1.5] Titles stripped of leading/trailing whitespace.
HISTORY [S1.6] Decision record: date filter introduced for monthly reconciliation runs.
API: export_records(records,user,params)->str; don't mutate input; ignore unknown params; records fields id,title,owner,project,status,amount(str kept),confidential,created,region,[updated].
CURRENT [S2.1] role viewer -> raise PermissionError, nothing exported.
CURRENT [S2.2] confidential True never exported, except role admin AND params purpose=='audit'; other rules still apply.
CURRENT [S2.3] params max_records int>=1: only first N (ascending id) after all other rules.
CURRENT [S2.4] Obligation: if format changes from CSV, every export in new format includes top-level "exported_by"=user['name'].
CURRENT [S2.5] Obligation: if confidential records ever exported for purpose other than audit, export includes top-level "confidential_count".
CURRENT [S2.6] region 'eu' exported only if 'eu' in user['regions'] (admins too).
Stages 1-2 implemented in exporter/core.py, tests pass. Helper regtool.py (load,save,affected,set_entry). Next: advance.
